 Alan Walker to Perform at BMIC 2026 as 16 BGMI Teams Fight for Rs 1 Crore
 By Deepti Pathak 
 October 27, 2026 October 27, 2026 
 BGMI fans will get to experience a live performance by Alan Walker at BMIC 2026 in Mumbai. KRAFTON India and District have revealed Walker as the headlining artist for the event. The artist connected with BGMI gamers in 2024 through his song “Hero.” The song was integrated into the game through the campaign called ‘Be A Hero’. It was also played in the resilience-themed in-game events. Now, Walker will perform live for the BGMI community at BMIC 2026. 
 Alan Walker, speaking on the matter, said:
 India, I’m coming home! The love I’ve received from BGMI players since ‘Hero’ became part of the game has been incredible, and I’m excited to perform for this community in person. BMIC 2026 brings together two things I’m passionate about – gaming and music – and I can’t wait to be part of it. Bring your squad, and let’s make some noise .
 BMIC 2026: Dates, Venue and Prize Pool
 BMIC 2026 will take place from October 30 to November 1 at the Dome, SVP Indoor Stadium (NSCI), in Mumbai. The three-day tournament will feature 16 teams from India, South Korea, and Japan. India will send six teams, while South Korea and Japan will each send five. The teams will compete for a Rs 1 crore prize pool and qualification spots for the Global Championship 2026. Fans who want to watch the matches live can book their tickets through District .
 India will have six teams competing at BMIC 2026, led by iQOO SouL, the winners of the BMSD 2026 championship. The other teams representing the country are Gladiators Esports, iQOO 8Bit, K9 Esports, Blitz Epigrotive Gaming, and Outrage Esports. All six teams earned their places through the competitive BGMI season. The Indian teams will face opponents from South Korea and Japan during the three-day tournament. With Alan Walker headlining the event, BMIC 2026 will also combine international esports matches with live music for fans in Mumbai.
